summary: GoodCause MVP first full E2E test. Backend: 26/26 pytest passing (100%) — auth, home, explore, campaign detail, donation sandbox flow (P0), follow/save/report, campaign builder create+submit, admin moderation (verify→publish), circles, notifications, AI assistant. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): auth register → home → detail → donate → success verified end-to-end. Sandbox donation completes, raised_kobo increases, supporters_count increments (40→41 observed), 'Test mode — no real money moved' disclaimer shown, prev→new percent displayed, donation-share-button rendered. Explore, Admin (verify/reject buttons visible), Profile, Circles (create modal), Campaign Builder step 1 all render with correct testIDs. No red screens, no page errors, no critical console errors.

issues: When donation amount is very small relative to goal (e.g. ₦1,000 vs ₦3M), prev% and new% appear identical (51% → 51%) due to rounding to integer. Consider showing 1 decimal or actual naira delta so donor sees real impact.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Occurs across screens. Should migrate style props (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) to boxShadow for RN Web/newer RN versions.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: Enhance donate success screen to show naira delta or decimal percent for small donations relative to goal (prev==new integer% is confusing UX).

VERIFY: Ensure `circle-code-input` and `circle-join-submit` testIDs exist on the Join-Circle modal (create modal was verified; join modal path not exercised — landing shows only 'Create a Circle' CTA).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_campaigns.py list_campaigns filter order: if `mine=False` sets status=LIVE but `status` query param then overrides — behavior is intentional (admin/organizer can request other statuses). OK.
routes_donations._apply_paid uses find_one_and_update with status guard for idempotency — good; verified via test that a repeated sandbox-complete does not double-count.
seed.py runs on every startup — ensure it is idempotent (looks upsert-based from behavior). No duplicate campaigns observed after multiple restarts.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider migrating to lifespan context manager for FastAPI ≥0.94.
ai_assistant.py: Gemini model 'gemini-3-flash-preview' — confirmed working via test (returned title/summary/story/expense_categories/social_copy).
routes_auth.py /logout deletes only user_sessions (Google) rows; JWT tokens remain valid until expiry. Acceptable for stateless JWT but note it in docs.
All routes correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection `{'_id': 0}`.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is inconsistent (browsers will block). Tighten before prod.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Backend seed.py auto-seeds admin, organizers, categories, and 10+ LIVE campaigns on startup. Tests created a handful of TEST_-prefixed users, one TEST_ campaign, and one TEST_ circle — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Uses seeded admin@goodcause.ng/Admin@12345, amina@goodcause.ng/Passw0rd! and creates fresh donor via /auth/register. Sandbox donation flow: POST /api/campaigns/{id}/donate returns sandbox=true+reference, then POST /api/donations/sandbox-complete {reference}. Frontend testIDs mostly present: auth-*, explore-search-input, explore-chip-*, trust-card, detail-support-button, detail-follow, detail-save, amount-*, custom-amount-input, anonymous-toggle, confirm-donate-button, donation-share-button, admin-tab-*, verify-<id>, reject-<id>, circle-name-input, circle-create-submit, builder-next, input-title. Join-circle modal testIDs not verified (circle-code-input, circle-join-submit).
